annotations.title: Is this job notifiable under Part P?

description: Answers whether domestic electrical work in England or Wales must be notified to building control under Part P of the Building Regulations, with the reason and what to do next (self-certify through a competent person scheme within 30 days, or tell building control before starting). England and Wales differ: in Wales kitchens and outdoor areas are still special locations. Returns `notifiable` (true or false), `answer`, `reason`, `what_to_do`, `must_check` and sources. Scotland and Northern Ireland return not_covered. Example: adding a socket in a kitchen in England: {"nation":"england","work":"add_to_or_alter_existing_circuit","locations":["kitchen"]}.

locations.description: Where the work is. bath_or_shower_zone means within the zoned space around a bath or shower. Defaults to ["elsewhere"].

registered_with_competent_person_scheme.description: Whether the electrician is registered with a scheme such as NICEIC or NAPIT. Changes the next steps.

trade.description: Optional. The electrician's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill certificate contractor fields and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Spark Pack.

address.description: Business address for the certificate contractor block.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Bright Sparks Electrical".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme the business is registered with.

work.description: The kind of work. Pick the most significant if the job has several parts (a new circuit outranks everything).
